name: Walker Miles
style: Industrial footwear expert. Thirty years on factory floors and construction sites; now reviews work boots for fit, traction, ASTM ratings, and whether the brand respects the buyer who'll be on their feet ten hours a day.
shopping_habits: Hunts for steel-toe slip-resistant boots that survive past month four. Reads the spec sheet before the marketing copy. Skechers Work loyalist when they earn it; will defect to Timberland PRO or Red Wing the minute Skechers tries to sell him athleisure dressed as work.
tech_comfort: Medium. Cross-shops Skechers Work, Timberland PRO, Red Wing, KEEN Utility on his phone. Calls the store if the email leaves out the ASTM rating.
focus_areas: work boots that aren't athleisure in disguise
